description: A balanced six-member company of Luna, backed by a baggage train of trained beasts and carts.

inventory.name: Iron Rations (1 week)
inventory.notes: Preserved food for 1 week. Lasts 2 months in wilderness, 1 week in dungeon. Cost 100-600cp depending on availability.

inventory.name: Saddle and Tack (pack)
inventory.notes: Purpose-built for cargo hauling. Supports panniers, saddlebags, sacks, barrels, and purses up to the animal's full capacity. Cannot be used for riding or vehicle hitching.

inventory.name: Panniers (wicker baskets, pair)
inventory.notes: Large wicker baskets hung from a pack saddle. Greater capacity than saddlebags but bulkier.

inventory.name: Dart (5)
inventory.notes: Bundle of 5 darts. Bundle weighs 1/6 stone. uses_remaining tracks darts left in the bundle (5 → 0).

inventory.name: Belladonna (1lb)
inventory.notes: If eaten within 1 hour of lycanthropy infection: save vs Poison or die in 1 turn; on success, avoids lycanthropy.

inventory.name: Lantern
inventory.notes: 30' radius birght light, additonal 20' radius dim light. Requires Oil Flask, Common to fuel.

inventory.name: Oil Flask, Common (1 pint)
inventory.notes: Fuels a lantern for 4 hours (24 turns).

inventory.name: Woundwart (1lb)
inventory.notes: Requires Healing proficiency. +2 bonus on cure light/serious wounds throws.

inventory.name: Saddle and Tack (draft)
inventory.notes: Harness and rigging for draft animals. Cannot be used for riding.

inventory.name: Iron Rations (1 week)
inventory.notes: Preserved food for 1 week. Lasts 2 months in wilderness, 1 week in dungeon. Cost 100-600cp depending on availability.

inventory.name: Standard Rations (1 week)
inventory.notes: Fresh food for 1 week. Spoils overnight in dank dungeons. Cost 30-300cp depending on availability.

inventory.name: Spear
inventory.notes: 1d6 one-handed, 1d8 two-handed. Can attack from second rank. Double damage on charge.

inventory.name: Torch
inventory.notes: 30' radius birght light, additonal 20' radius dim light. Sold in bundles of 6 (cost is per-bundle). Burns 6 turns (1 hour). Can be used as an improvised melee weapon (1d4 fire damage).

inventory.name: Tinderbox (flint and steel)
inventory.notes: Lighting a torch takes a full round.

inventory.name: Journal
inventory.notes: 50 pages. Less sturdy than a spell book. Source: pc_equipment_catalog.

inventory.name: Thieves' Tools
inventory.notes: Required for Open Locks and Find/Remove Traps throws.
